limitations: Two distinct defects. (1) possibly_discontinued_instrument: TOEFL PBT (paper-based) and TOEFL CBT (computer-based) were discontinued by ETS as general-public admissions test formats years ago (CBT ~2006; classic PBT phased out worldwide well before 2026) - a student cannot actually sit these formats today, so 'PBT: 600' and 'CBT: 250' are dead pathways still listed as if valid. (2) undated_scale_assumption on the surviving iBT figure: 'internet-based: 100' is given with no cutover-date acknowledgment; ETS rescaled TOEFL iBT to a 1-6 average scale effective 21 January 2026 and provides a comparable 0-120 overall score for two years, so 100/120 likely remains satisfiable via that comparable score, but the page does not say so. Cambridge Proficiency/Advanced grade-C thresholds are unaffected by the TOEFL rescale (separate, unchanged instrument).
researcher_notes: Same pattern as the Boğaziçi University finding in requirements_batch5_scale-audit (REQ-2026-08-21-4006): an old-scale TOEFL figure stated with no cutover date, found by auditing every English-proficiency row rather than only where two sources conflicted.
